summary: Defines a SIP media feature tag that lets a user agent say which MIME application subtypes it can handle. Callers can then use caller preferences to reach a device that supports the kind of application they want to use in a session. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Before sending a package, you might want to know whether the other side has the right tool to open it. This tag lets a phone announce which kinds of application data it can handle.
